lesson.title: Review Day: Place Value, Addition, and Subtraction
lesson.subject: math

contentBlocks.text: This week you learned place value, carrying, borrowing, and three-digit addition. Today is review day — no new strategies, just practice putting it all together.

Let's mix it up: break apart a number by place value, add two numbers with carrying, subtract two numbers with borrowing, and add two three-digit numbers. Which part felt easiest this week? Which would you like more practice with?
You've built a real toolkit for working with big numbers this week. Next week, we'll keep building on these same skills.

objectives: Demonstrate all four skills practiced this week — place value, carrying, borrowing, and three-digit addition — in one cumulative activity
Self-identify which strategy feels most secure and which needs more practice
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Walk through all four skills in sequence: break apart a number, add with carrying, subtract with borrowing, add three-digit numbers.
2. Ask which part felt easiest and which felt hardest — this guides next week's pacing.
3. Move to the worksheet: complete the mixed review problems.
4. Praise effort and progress across the whole week, not just today's performance.
5. Close by previewing that next week continues building on these same skills.
differentiationTips: Struggling: spend extra time on whichever single skill felt hardest, rather than requiring equal practice across all four
Ready for more: create a new three-digit addition or subtraction problem and solve it together
For a child who enjoys games, turn this into a quick quiz-show format with the week's problems
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: A dedicated review day after a full week of related place-value and computation strategies matches the platform's established pacing pattern — consolidation before adding more content is essential.
